text:
maria-devx: Heads up, customer AtlasAI reporting a sudden ~30% 503 failure rate on hosted inference around 12:02 UTC after a model hot-swap. Streaming sockets hang and requests never return.
aj-oncall: on it — any deploys/infra changes at that time?
mar ia-devx: no infra deploys. We swapped to a quantized variant of redwood-embed-v2 at 12:01:50. Errors start ~12:02:10. Auth looks fine (no 401s).
samir-sre: can you paste the runner logs / kernel messages? any SIG*?
maria-devx: pasted minimal tail from the host log:
```
2026-03-18T12:02:09Z infer-runner[4821]: accepted connection fd=67 streaming=true model=redwood-embed-quant-v2
2026-03-18T12:02:10Z infer-runner[4821]: rpc: recv chunk size=65536 seq_len=18000 batch=10
2026-03-18T12:02:11Z infer-runner[4821]: kernel launch failed: PTX_UNKNOWN_INSTR (nvptx)
2026-03-18T12:02:11Z kernel: infer-runner(4821): segfault at 0x7ff... ip 0x555... sigill
2026-03-18T12:02:11Z systemd: infer-runner.service: main process exited, code=killed, status=4/ILL
2026-03-18T12:02:12Z containerd: restarting container infer-runner
```
aj-oncall: SIGILL + immediate restart — looks like an invalid device instruction emitted (PTX). Could be bad kernel selection for this quantized kernel.
eng-linh: Repro recipe I used in staging that triggers a similar path: POST /v1/stream?model=redwood-embed-quant-v2 with a payload that yields sequence ~18k tokens and batch=8-12 concurrently. Command: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d @big_payload.json https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream` (payload attached in thread).
samir-sre: thanks. Can you also confirm GPU driver + cu version? we need nvml and dmesg output.
maria-devx: driver: 535.104, cuda 12.2. nvml shows no memory leak prior to crash. dmesg excerpt above included the segfault. Collecting core dump and nvrun traces now.
aj-oncall: Temporary mitigations: 1) Route new AtlasAI traffic to dedicated fallback pool (non-quant, CPU-safe model) — flipped routing policy to fallback-tier at 12:08 UTC. 2) Increased watchdog to kill slower prefetch attempts earlier. 3) Throttle concurrent streaming batch sizes for hosted tier until patch. :white_check_mark:
cs-jordan: informing AtlasAI CS rep, offering 10% credit for impacted window. Sending customer note now.
eng-linh: root cause hypothesis: quantized kernel path picks an optimized PTX for recent sm86/90 instruction that our compiled kernel doesn't match (we shipped a kernel variant that uses an instruction not supported on this driver's nvptx target) — triggers SIGILL under specific sequence lengths that hit that codepath. We'll try a build fallback that forces the generic PTX path.
samir-sre: plan: a) reproduce in a controlled node with same driver+cuda and the long-seq payload (eng-linh will attempt), b) gather core + nvcrash + full `journalctl -u infer-runner` logs, c) roll back hot-swap for quantized model globally until we push a patched kernel.
aj-oncall: I've opened PD incident PD-2026-314 and assigned to eng-linh and samir-sre. Notifying infra for node isolation if repeat crashes show hardware faults.
maria-devx: attaching core dump location and nvcrash id: nvcrash-20260318-120211-4821.tar.gz (uploading to /artifacts/incidents/6188880000).
eng-linh: quick follow-up: I repro'd locally with the staging image and the big payload — same SIGILL when batch>=9 and seq>16k. Pushed a canary that forces interpreter PTX path to staging; no crash so far. Will bake for 20m then prepare a rollback/patch for prod.
samir-sre: next steps: capture perf+cuda kernel trace, add extra assertion to detect PTX_UNKNOWN_INSTR before it kills process and fallback to interpreter path, and coordinate a global rollback of quantized model hot-swap if canary fails.
cs-jordan: Customer update sent: we informed AtlasAI of routing to fallback model, mitigation in place, investigating root cause, will follow up with timeline + credit.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-2026-314 acknowledged by eng-linh at 2026-03-18T12:10:12Z.
aj-oncall: keeping this channel updated. If anyone sees repeat crashes on other pools, ping here and we'll escalate to hardware.
maria-devx: thanks all — collecting final artifacts and will post postmortem follow-up once we have kernel patch and rollout plan. :pray:
